name: homie
description: Homie for game studios: make multiplayer web games in Claude Code or Codex, run your studio's site and public rooms on your own Cloudflare, and list the games in the homie.rocks directory.

plugins.name: homie
plugins.description: Set up a game studio, make or remix multiplayer games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer (netplay public rooms, bots, rounds), preview them locally, deploy the studio's site to its own Cloudflare, and publish to the homie.rocks directory.
